stance_rationale: The package is an architecture/protocol draft, not a verifiable alpha package: alpha_vector is empty, diagnostics are null, and required alpha_scores/weights/covariance artifacts are absent. It also silently departs from the base hard universe constraint and contains spec-level bugs that can violate max_names and invalidate the claimed Sharpe surrogate.

time_series_alpha_audit.comment: alpha_scores.parquet and weights.csv for WT-D20260519_001 are absent in both requested artifact locations; the claimed 124 effective sig_dates and 52 test months are design promises, not realized schedule evidence.

No DD/VT overlay is used in the core DPL design; optional m4 inheritance remains unverified if enabled.
Spec states annual May and quarterly 45d lag via factor_db_connector; this remains spec-level because no feature realization artifact was emitted for this WT.

critical_concerns.description: The required realized alpha artifacts are missing: alpha_scores.parquet, weights.csv, covariance.parquet, final alpha_package.json, and challenge_note are absent; diagnostics are null and alpha_vector is empty. This fails RF-A7/time-series alpha verification and prevents IC, liquidity, turnover, and AX-008 checks.

The package uses KR_TOP500_LIQ1E8/free universe, while the base hard constraint requires Universe = KOSPI200 ∪ KOSDAQ150. If this is an intentional override, it requires explicit No Silent Override disposition; none exists.

Rawdata provenance is not reproducible: the package claims rawdata.parquet sha256 c86e4ae5..., but root rawdata.parquet is absent and the only located .cache/rawdata.parquet hashes to 1370cae0.... PIT/C15 pass cannot rest on a non-matching source.

Partial adjustment after top-K can violate the hard max_names=20 constraint: a convex mix of old top-20 and new top-20 holdings can create up to 40 active names unless re-topK/reprojection occurs after adjustment.

The stated Sharpe surrogate is mathematically broken in the provided skeleton: r_p is a scalar per sig_date, so r_p.std() is undefined/degenerate and the loss collapses toward scaled mean return, reviving the v1 loss-instability problem.
C14 is labeled PASS_PENDING_FORGE_EMIT, but no ic_history or alpha_scores artifact exists. Pending evidence is not a PIT pass, especially for IC access and Usable_Date <= sig_date.

AX-005/AX-007 compliance is overclaimed: the design is still a single-sleeve top-20 long-only portfolio with a 55% defensive-heavy feature mix, and HHI > 0.06 would only prove non-EW sizing, not sufficient economic mechanism validity.

Multiple-testing control is incomplete. n_trials=100 covers planned hyperparameter trials, but not the architecture selection path across v1-v5 lessons and deferred alternatives; actual Harvey 5-spec and DSR outputs are missing.

The package has as_of_date 2026-05-19 while the execution environment date is 2026-05-18T08:02:21+09:00; without a realized last sig_date artifact, future-dated package metadata weakens PIT timestamp discipline.

supporting_arguments: feature_allowlist_v2.csv exists and its observed sha256 matches the package claim b3d667517a39e4ebf219988f67c2cc6e22f4fb6350f5d6a5e52976fb4a8fb6ee.
The stage documents do enumerate reasonable future gates for PIT, HHI, turnover, DSR, Harvey t, and AX-008, but these are protocols rather than evidence.
C4/C9/C13 are specified coherently at the design level, subject to later implementation audit.

How the model will compute a valid Sharpe surrogate across time when the declared batch is one sig_date.

Whether FF5/FF6 are genuine KR factor regressions or structural duplicates in this WT.

Emit weights.csv and prove per-sig_date max_names <= 20, weights in [0,0.20], sum(weights)=1, long-only, turnover < 600% annual, and LIQ_20d >= 2e8.
Resolve the universe conflict against KOSPI200 ∪ KOSDAQ150 or provide explicit No Silent Override disposition.
Resolve rawdata path/hash mismatch and rerun PIT C15/C14 evidence from the actual loaded source.
Fix the Sharpe surrogate so variance is computed across a valid time/window distribution, not a scalar per sig_date.
Move top-K/projection after partial_adjust or otherwise prove the final portfolio cannot exceed 20 active names.
Provide rank_IC, ICIR, Harvey t, DSR, monotonicity, post-neutralization IC, subperiod stability, and RF-A1~A7 dispositions.
Provide challenge_note and artifact_lineage with write_json to record_lineage ordering.
